caption: The drawing depicts a single antique revolver with a long barrel positioned horizontally across the center of a plain beige background. The revolver's handle, colored in dark brown with a hint of reddish undertone and highlighted by a metallic-looking base plate in gray, curves downward. The trigger guard and adjacent area consist of a brass or gold-toned component. The main body, cylinder, and barrel of the revolver are rendered in varying shades of steel gray and black, with detailing indicating mechanisms such as the hammer, trigger, and cylinder chambers. At the lower right corner of the drawing, the text "BERNARD KRIEGER CITY MUSEUM (3RD FLOOR)" is handwritten in dark ink. There are no other objects or features present in the drawing aside from the revolver and the inscription.
title: Colt Revolver
